observations: Photo 0 shows a white Xbox One controller with a custom 'Cyclentam' skin, resting on a yellow and red Xbox One console box.
Photo 1 shows the same console with a yellow top and red side, wrapped in a black protective sleeve.
The console has a vertical design with a disc slot on the left side.
The controller has a red power button and a blue trigger button visible in photo 0.
Watermark 'TEMMY'S BRIGHT' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' are present on both images.

claims.evidence: The console appears clean in photos, but 'lightly used' is a subjective term for cosmetic condition.
No photo shows the console powered on or connected to a screen.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The console may not power on or may have a faulty disc drive.
risks.proof: A video of the console booting to the home screen.

risks.risk: The controller may have stick drift or unresponsive buttons.
risks.proof: A video of the controller being used to navigate menus or play a game.

risks.risk: The console may have a hardware failure or overheating issues.
risks.proof: A video showing the console running for at least 10 minutes without errors.

risks.risk: The console may be a lower-spec model (e.g., 500GB instead of 1TB).
risks.proof: A photo of the 'System Storage' screen in the settings.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and navigating the home screen.
Video of the controller being used to play a game.
Photo of the 'System Storage' screen showing the total capacity.
Photo of the 'System Information' screen showing the model number.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
